title: New Orleans Chillhop 🚆
description:
Departing daily: live train rides around the world, 24/7 → youtube.com/@LofiTrainPOV/streams

Settle into a window seat for a cozy train ride through an illustrated New Orleans on a warm summer evening: French Quarter balconies glowing with lamplight, St. Louis Cathedral, a paddle-wheel steamboat on the Mississippi and the skyline glowing under a sunset sky, with mellow chillhop the whole way.

Lofi Train POV: cozy illustrated train-window journeys through the world's cities, set to relaxing chillhop. A new city every day. Sit back, look out the window, and stay as long as you like.

Stylised illustrated artwork; not real footage.
Music: "Solitude" and "Alley Cat" by Purrple Cat (purrplecat.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Tracks were trimmed and cross-faded.
